answer.answer: The National Health Authority (NHA) implements the Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare [E01]. PM-JAY is described as the largest health assurance scheme in the world, which aims to provide cashless health insurance coverage of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization to poor and vulnerable families [E02].
